name: browser-use
headline: internal-comms: Team Communication
short_description: The internal-comms skill streamlines communication within organizations by automating routine messaging and updates. It enhances team collaboration and ensures timely information sharing, saving valuable time for employees.
author: anthropics

sections.overview:
The internal-comms skill is designed to enhance internal communication within organizations by automating routine messaging tasks. By leveraging AI automation, this skill allows teams to send updates, reminders, and announcements without manual intervention, ensuring that important information reaches the right people at the right time. With 2,353 installs, it has proven to be a valuable tool for improving workplace efficiency. One of the key benefits of the internal-comms skill is its ability to save time and reduce the cognitive load on employees. By automating repetitive communication tasks, teams can focus on more strategic initiatives, leading to increased productivity. For instance, instead of manually sending out weekly updates, a project manager can set up automated messages that inform team members of project milestones and deadlines, freeing up hours each week. This skill is particularly beneficial for product managers, developers, and AI practitioners who require seamless communication across various teams. It can be utilized in scenarios such as notifying team members of changes in project scope, scheduling meetings, or sharing important company announcements. The implementation is straightforward, making it accessible for users with varying levels of technical expertise. In an AI-first workflow, the internal-comms skill fits perfectly by integrating with existing tools and platforms, facilitating a more cohesive communication strategy. Whether it's through Slack, email, or other messaging platforms, this skill ensures that teams remain aligned and informed. By adopting this automation, organizations can enhance their internal communication strategies and drive better collaboration across departments.
Automating weekly project status updates to keep team members informed.
Sending reminders for upcoming deadlines and meetings to ensure timely participation.
Distributing company-wide announcements efficiently to reach all employees.
Notifying teams of changes in project scope or priorities to maintain alignment.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create a weekly internal update email for [TEAM NAME] at [COMPANY]. Include key achievements from the past week, upcoming priorities, and any important announcements. Use a professional yet engaging tone. Ensure the email is concise and no longer than 3 paragraphs.
```
Copy

```
Subject: Weekly Update - Marketing Team at TechInnovate Solutions

Dear Team,

This week, we successfully launched the new product campaign, which has already generated a 20% increase in leads. The social media team's creative content strategy has been particularly effective, with engagement rates up by 15%. A big shoutout to Sarah for her outstanding work on the campaign visuals!

Looking ahead, our focus will be on analyzing the campaign's performance metrics and refining our targeting strategies. We also have a team-building event scheduled for next Friday, which promises to be a fun and engaging experience. Please ensure you mark your calendars and participate actively.

Lastly, a reminder that the quarterly review meetings will begin next week. Prepare your reports and be ready to share your progress and insights. Let's continue to collaborate and achieve great things together!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
